Step.Text: @purpose: The primary purpose of this script is to provide a test bed for script steps. It contains every script step with more or less every combination of possible parameters.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: It is specifically used by @mrwatson-de to check the output of fmCheckMate's Print Script Step XSLT transformation function (which converts a FileMaker clipboard script or script step fmxmlsnippet to FileMaker script text)

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: It is also available in @mirslavkos's Ooe-fm (One of Everything FileMaker) file as a test bed for SaXML & co.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: To test fmCheckMate's Print Script Step XSLT transformation you need

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: - the latest version of FileMaker Pro

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: 1. Prepare the test environment as above

Step.Text: 2. Diff the function results with the actual script text

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: a. Open fmSyntaxColorizer (or Ooe-fm) and copy all steps from this script (CMD+A, CMD+C)

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: b. Open fmWorkMate > fmTextDiff and add the clipboard contents to the diff (CMD+7, CMD+7)

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: c. Return to fmSyntaxColorizer and copy the selected step text (Right Click > Copy Selected // MBS function)

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: d. In fmTextDiff add the clipboard contents to the diff (CMD+7)
